content: Sharḥ Khuṭbat al-Kashshāf is a brief commentary on the prologue to Zamakhsharī's Kashshāf; the author states that it is to be used as a model or key for interpreting the rest of the book. Melvin-Koushki notes that Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's lettrism presupposes an uncreated Quran, so he is here and elsewhere at pains to expose the pernicious aspects of Zamakhsharī's Muʿtazilī work.
